integrity: Exact integer enumeration with two independently constructed ideal sets, direct signed low-degree sums and full Walsh transforms. Public checker reproduces numbers from definitions.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact result for the 2-by-2-by-6 box only. First occurrence verified for widths 1 through 6, not larger widths. The norm-optimal projection theorem uses translation averaging, not an original method. No independently performed mathematical audit; historical priority comparison is bounded.
title: First cubic Walsh blind characters for \(2\times2\times6\) boxed plane partitions
